$description: Semantic color roles, resolved per color scheme. These are imprint-independent — every site shares them; only the accent (tokens/accents.json) differs. Orientation is consistent across schemes: `surface` is a RAISED panel (lighter in dark, cleaner in light), `well` is a RECESSED code/table tint (darker in dark, tinted in light). References into palette.gruvbox.json are resolved at build time.

well.$description: Recessed fills: code/pre wells, table zebra stripe.

fg.$description: Body text. Contrast-gated AA on bg, surface, and well.

fg-muted.$description: Secondary text (captions, meta). Contrast-gated AA on bg and surface.

fg-subtle.$description: Tertiary/decorative text. Gated at AA-large only — do not use for body copy.
